scenarios.label: Measured per-trade spread (entry/exit bars)
scenarios.note: Uses the per-bar spread of each trade's entry and exit candles (averaged into one width). Measured, not assumed; trades without a per-bar spread fall back to the measured mean and are counted as such.

scenarios.label: Measured historical mean spread
scenarios.note: Mean of the per-bar spread over the window; measured, single width per trade.

scenarios.label: Measured historical median spread
scenarios.note: median of the measured per-bar spread over the window.

scenarios.label: Measured historical p90 spread
scenarios.note: p90 of the measured per-bar spread over the window.

scenarios.label: Measured historical p95 spread
scenarios.note: p95 of the measured per-bar spread over the window.

scenarios.label: Measured historical p99 spread
scenarios.note: p99 of the measured per-bar spread over the window.

scenarios.label: Measured spread + $7/lot round-turn commission
scenarios.note: Commission is an ASSUMPTION (no broker spec supplied); contract_size=100, cost_price=0.07.

scenarios.note: Swap from the instrument's points-mode terms applied per overnight rollover; an ASSUMPTION about the rollover schedule.
